kuma_url.label: Kuma URL
kuma_url.description: Base URL of your Uptime Kuma server, http:// or https://. With http:// the key and password travel in clear text.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.description: A Kuma API key, used for /metrics and /api/monitors. Stored in clear text in the noctalia settings file: create a key just for this plugin.

proxy_user.label: Status page user
proxy_user.description: Basic auth user in front of your status pages (for example a reverse proxy). Leave empty if they are public.

proxy_password.label: Status page password
proxy_password.description: Password for the status page user. Sent only to the hosts of the status pages listed below.

status_pages.label: Status pages
status_pages.description: One URL per page, like https://host/status/<slug>.

kuma3_support.label: Kuma 3 support
kuma3_support.description: Use /api/monitors (Kuma 3, API enabled) to show the real groups. Leave off on Kuma 2: the plugin then groups by tag.

bar_display.label: Bar display
bar_display.description: What the bar widget shows next to the icon.

bar_label.label: Bar text
bar_label.description: Text shown to the left of the heart icon. Leave empty to hide it.

start_collapsed.label: Start collapsed
start_collapsed.description: Open the Dashboard with every group collapsed.

start_tab.label: Opens on
start_tab.description: Tab shown when the panel opens.

error.no_url: Set the Kuma URL in the plugin settings.
error.no_key: Set the API key in the plugin settings.
error.v3_api_off: The Kuma 3 API is not enabled on this server.
error.bad_url: Not a valid status page URL.
error.bad_metrics: The server did not answer with Kuma metrics. Check the URL and that /metrics is enabled.

panel.warn_http: This server is reached over plain http: the API key and passwords travel in clear text.
panel.pages_empty: No status pages configured. Add their URLs in the plugin settings.
panel.add_bad_url: Not a valid status page URL (https://host/status/<slug>).
panel.tip_tag_first: Each monitor appears once, under its first tag. Click to show it under every tag.
panel.tip_tag_all: A monitor with several tags appears under each. Click to show it once, under its first tag.
